title: First-second hook
rationale: A vertical social clip lives or dies in its first second. This asks for one specific, striking opening shot and judges whether it would stop a scroll, whether it is the shot that was asked for, and whether it works with the sound off.
prompt: The opening of a vertical social video for a coffee brand: a cup is knocked off a table, freezes in mid-air with the coffee suspended, then the camera whips around it. The first second must be impossible to scroll past. No text, no logo.

variants.prompt: The opening of a vertical social video for a running shoe: a shoe lands in a puddle in extreme slow motion, the splash forming a crown, then normal speed snaps back as the runner leaves frame. No text, no logo.
The opening of a vertical social video for a skincare brand: a single drop of serum falls onto glass and spreads into a perfect circle. Extreme macro, clean white light. No text, no logo.
The opening of a vertical social video for a burger restaurant: a knife slices a burger in half straight toward the camera, cheese stretching between the halves. No text, no logo.
The opening of a vertical social video for a gym: a kettlebell drops onto a rubber floor right in front of the lens, chalk dust lifts, the camera jolts on impact. No text, no logo.

rubric: Would you stop scrolling in the first second?
Is it the shot the prompt asked for?
Does it work with the sound off?
Craft, and no text or logo anywhere
